flow.step: It finds the piece from a photo or a few words
flow.detail: The buyer sends a photo or types flower pendant, 18K white gold. The agent searches the whole catalogue on what the record holds and on what is visible in the photo, and replies in one message with the closest pieces, their photos and the prices in your record. When there are too many matches it asks one narrowing question, budget or diamond size, before it shows more.

flow.step: It says which outlet holds it
flow.detail: Stock sits per outlet in the catalogue, so the reply says the piece is at your Tampines shop today, or that it is one of a kind. In the demo we built, a piece that has sold is hidden from search, and a second buyer asking for it is told it has just been taken.

flow.step: It holds your price and takes the deposit
flow.detail: The agent quotes only what the record says. Pushed for a better price, it holds. When the buyer wants a person, it hands over, and the price stays where you set it. To hold a piece it sends a payment link for a deposit. Once paid, the piece is marked reserved and the outlet gets a WhatsApp message to take it off the counter.

flow.step: It hands over what it should not answer
flow.detail: Pawn ticket questions and valuations of a customer's own gold go to your staff, with the chat so far. Gold by weight is handled the same way on Starter: the agent says the team will share the live rate and pings your staff. On Pro a live rate source can be connected, ask us before you count on it.

flow.step: It follows up and keeps the lead
flow.detail: Every buyer's name and number are stored from the first message. A buyer who paid a deposit but has not come down is reminded. A buyer who stopped replying is followed up. Your staff see the whole chat when they take over, so the buyer never repeats the story.

faq: Can an AI agent search a jewellery catalogue of 100,000 pieces on WhatsApp?

Yes, if the catalogue is in a file or a store it can read. The agent does not scan every record on each message. The catalogue is indexed once, then searched by category and by what is visible in the photo. The group we spoke to sent 100 pieces as they were, bare titles and small thumbnails, and we built the demo on those without a re-shoot. Hard facts like purity, weight and carat come from your record only, the agent never guesses them.
What stops a double sale, where the shop sells a piece someone has just bought online?

On Starter the agent takes a deposit by payment link and marks the piece reserved so no other buyer is offered it. Your outlet gets a WhatsApp message to take it off the counter. Between your daily sold file and that message there is still a window of up to a day. On Pro the agent connects to your stock system, so a counter sale takes the piece out of the chat within the conversation. If your IT will not open the stock system, start on Starter and accept the window.
Does it quote the live gold price?

For diamond and gem pieces it quotes the price in your record. For gold by weight on Starter it tells the buyer the team will share the live rate and hands the chat to your staff. On Pro we can connect the rate source you already use, and the quote is locked at the moment the buyer confirms. Tell us your rate source before you count on this.
Can it tell a customer which outlet has the piece?

Yes, when your catalogue file or stock system holds the outlet for each piece. The reply names the outlet and says if the piece is one of a kind. If your stock file does not record the outlet, the agent says the team will confirm and pings your staff.
Can it answer pawn ticket questions?

No. The agent does not value a customer's gold and does not answer questions about a pawn ticket or its due date. It recognises those messages and hands them to your counter staff, or to a separate number you give us, with the chat so far. Put the agent on your jewellery sales line and keep the pawn line with your staff.

How long does it take to go live, and do we need our IT team?

Live in 48 hours from your product list. For Starter your IT team is not needed, a catalogue export and a daily sold list are enough. For Pro we need access to your store or stock system, which is a short task for whoever runs it. Before you pay, we build the agent and you message it. Then one free hour: we walk you through the platform and connect payments and your WhatsApp number.
Will the agent give discounts on its own?

No. It quotes the price in your record and holds it. If you give it a rule, such as a set discount above a set basket size, it applies only that rule. When a buyer pushes past the rule, it hands the chat to a person. It never invents a lower price.
